name: Bright Suburb
niche: Second-person 'what if' superpower stories in an everyday suburb: home, school, work, then the whole world, with one or two real-world fact asides
audience: English-speaking teens and young adults (13-25) who like long, funny, slightly dark thought experiments
title_rules: Start with 'What If'; second person; under 60 characters; one concrete power
thumbnail_rules: Yellow-hooded sphere-head hero close-up with a strong expression, one pink glow label, bright room background, 2-3 word caps text

decisions.text: Follow the bright-suburb STRUCTURE.md (7 acts, time-stamp mini-scenes, consequences ladder, 'So would you...?' closer); stories, lines, characters and names stay our own.
